text: Is F-Droid a hard v1 requirement (vs best-effort/later)? This is the single biggest technology filter: it bans ML Kit / Play-Services-only SDKs from shared code and drives reproducible-build engineering.
Will WLO ship on Play Store (in addition to F-Droid/sideload), ever?
What minSdk floor is acceptable? (No floor is stated anywhere in the docs; it gates haptics vocabulary at API 30/34, Health Connect, and ARCore coverage.)
suggestions: Let research decide (device-share vs API needs)

text: App-size budget: is a ~50–80 MB bundled model-zoo APK acceptable, or should heavy models (STT 45–85 MB, LLM) be download-on-first-use only?
Any iOS or Kotlin-Multiplatform ambition, even distant? (No iOS ambition appears anywhere in the docs; a KMP-ready core would flip the persistence/HTTP/DI choices.)
Crash/feedback policy: docs ban telemetry with content (F13 §9). Which channel?
Owner reframe 2026-09-11: F-Droid is not a requirement. Play Store + GitHub APKs; F-Droid optional later via clean-stack audit. Recorded as R-S13.
Owner reframe 2026-09-11: yes — Play Store (primary, with GitHub-release APKs). Recorded in R-S13 / T-A4.

- F-Droid: **not required** → Play Store + GitHub APKs (Q1/Q2 resolved).
- License: **Apache-2.0** (was GPLv3). openScale GPL scale drivers → clean-room reimpl.

## Owner decisions 2026-09-11 (Q3–Q6, approved suggestions)
- **minSdk = API 29 (Android 10)** (q-000023). Haptics degrade gracefully below 30/34 per DESIGN-SYSTEM §5.
- **Model zoo: download-on-first-use only; the APK ships no zoo models** (q-000024) → R-S14.
  Airplane-mode parity holds once a model is present; capabilities degrade to R-U15 manual
  paths until then. Vendor-SDK built-in models (ML Kit libs) are a tracked exception pending
  the Phase-B size audit.

  follows the KMP fork (ADR-001/003/004).
- **Crash policy: opt-in content-free ACRA reports** (q-000026). Transmitting ⇒ consent

text:
All four decisions acted on and the questions resolved. Phase A research completed
2026-09-11; ADRs accepted in docs/tech/adr/:
- ADR-001: KMP-ready core + Android UI; Koin 4.2 in commonMain; JVM purity target in CI.
- ADR-002: minSdk 29 validated (~9% coverage cost; nothing the app needs sits above 29);
  Play release flags recorded (health-apps declaration; org-account requirement for
  health apps reported Jan 2026 — verify before release; AI-content policy applies to F12).
- ADR-003: Room 2.8.x (KMP) + DataStore 1.2.1; Room-3.0 hedge via SQLiteDriver APIs.
- ADR-004: kotlinx.serialization 1.9 + Ktor 3.4.x/SSE; document-evolution house rules.
Next: Phase B — AI/capture stack (T-E1 runtime matrix, per-capability models, min-spec spike).

**Implementation plan ratified — 2026-09-12.** Six milestone tickets created (each with
objectives, scope, documentation references, and acceptance criteria in its spec;
chained blocked-by; related to this ticket):

- **WLO-0023 · M1** Walking skeleton — scaffold per ARCHITECTURE.md, ADR-005 ratification, app shell, CI
- **WLO-0024 · M2** Data spine + onboarding (F01, F07 Transparent engine + cold-start)
- **WLO-0025 · M3** Manual daily loop (F02 manual, F06, F10 minimal)
- **WLO-0026 · M4** Capture stack — opens with T-E1/T-E2 spike + R-S14 zoo plumbing
- **WLO-0027 · M5** Plan → shop pipeline (F03 planner, F04 list/pantry)
- **WLO-0028 · M6** Vault + AI platform shell (F13 backup/export, F12 consent/receipts)

Sequencing rationale: data spine before features, manual paths before AI assists (R-U15),
the parked JIT spike lands at the front of M4. Post-M6 backlog (not ticketed yet):
F09 gut, F08 silhouette (owns its vision spike), F05, F11, widget, cloud BYOK, converters,
Health Connect.
